Name: Breech-Loader
Description: This pistol can load cartridges through a breech mechanism, allowing for faster reloading.

Name: Buckler Gun
Description: This pistol is built into a buckler, allowing you to use both weapons simultaneously.

Name: Coat Pistol
Description: This small pistol is designed to be concealed in clothing.

Name: Dagger Pistol
Description: This weapon combines a dagger with a pistol, allowing both melee and ranged attacks.

Name: Double-Barreled Pistol
Description: This pistol has two parallel barrels; each can be shot independently or both at once with a –4 penalty.

Name: Dragon Pistol
Description: Similar to a blunderbuss, a dragon pistol fires pellets from a flared barrel. It has the scatter weapon quality (10 ft.).

Name: Dragoon Pistol
Description: This pistol is designed for cavalry use and has an extended range.

Name: Paddle-Foot Pistol
Description: This pistol has a paddle-shaped handle and can fire scatter shot.

Name: Pepperbox
Description: This pistol has six barrels instead of one. Each barrel can be shot independently.

Name: Pistol
Description: The single-shot pistol is one of the most common firearms.

Name: Sword Cane Pistol
Description: This sword cane conceals a small pistol mechanism.

Name: Air Repeater
Description: This weapon uses compressed air instead of black powder. It must be pumped before use.

Name: Axe Musket
Description: This musket has an axe blade attached, allowing both ranged and melee attacks.

Name: Blunderbuss
Description: This weapon fires pellets or a bullet from its trumpet-shaped barrel. It has the scatter weapon quality (15 ft.).

Name: Culverin
Description: The culverin is a hand bombard. Firing without support imparts a –4 penalty and knocks you prone on a misfire.

Name: Cylinder Rifle
Description: This rifle has a revolving cylinder that holds 8 rounds.

Name: Double Hackbut
Description: This oversized musket has two barrels and deals tremendous damage.

Name: Double-Barreled Musket
Description: This musket has two parallel barrels; each can be fired independently or both at once with a –4 penalty.

Name: Dragoon Musket
Description: This musket is designed for cavalry use and has extended range.

Name: Fire Lance
Description: This simple firearm is a tube attached to a spear. It can only be fired once.

Name: Musket
Description: This long-barreled firearm has a much greater range than a pistol.

Name: Warhammer Musket
Description: This musket has a warhammer head attached, allowing both ranged and melee attacks.

Name: Radium Pistol
Description: This advanced pistol uses radioactive ammunition. See text for special radiation effects.

Name: Revolver
Description: A revolver is a pistol with a revolving cylinder containing six chambers. The cylinder automatically rotates.

Name: Double-Barreled Shotgun
Description: This shotgun has two barrels. It can fire both at once with a –4 penalty. It has the scatter weapon quality (30 ft.).

Name: Pepperbox Rifle
Description: This rifle has four rotating barrels.

Name: Radium Rifle
Description: This advanced rifle uses radioactive ammunition. See text for special radiation effects.

Name: Rifle
Description: A rifle is a long-barreled firearm with excellent range and accuracy.

Name: Shotgun
Description: This advanced version of the blunderbuss shoots in a 30-foot cone when firing pellets.

Name: Thark Rifle
Description: This exotic rifle has an incredible range of 1 mile. See text for special properties.

Name: Nagant M1895 Revolver
Description: This modern revolver holds 7 rounds. It uses metal cartridges.

Name: Lawrence 1917 Flamethrower
Description: This flamethrower projects a cone of fire. Requires fuel tank.

Name: Madsen Light Machine Gun
Description: This light machine gun has the automatic special quality.

Name: Maxim M1910 Machine Gun
Description: This heavy machine gun has the automatic special quality and requires mounting.

Name: Mosin-Nagant M1891 Rifle
Description: This modern rifle uses metal cartridges.
